heading: What does this PDF optimizer actually reduce?
introduction: This tool removes selected PDF metadata and rewrites the document structure. It does not downsample scanned pages or recompress embedded photographs, so image-heavy or already optimized PDFs may barely shrink.

sections.heading: Try a structural rewrite
sections.body: Add an unsigned, unencrypted PDF within the 50 MB input limit and start processing. The output is parsed again and its page count checked before a download is offered. Compare the reported size with the original.

sections.heading: Know when another approach is needed
sections.body: Large scanned PDFs often need image or scan-resolution changes for a substantial reduction. Those operations are not offered here. The optimizer does not perform OCR, remove passwords or promise a particular percentage saving.

sections.heading: Inspect the document before keeping it
sections.body: Open the download in your PDF reader and review pages, forms, links and appearance. Detected digitally signed and encrypted PDFs are refused. Keep the original because a successful parse and matching page count do not prove every document feature is unchanged.

seoTitle: PDF Optimizer — Rewrite Structure and Metadata
seoDescription: Optimize PDF structure and remove selected metadata locally. Embedded images are not recompressed, and scanned PDFs may see little size reduction.
